title: SearchHit
description: One result of a search, as a client sees it (master plan 14.2, 12.5): the source's ID, authorised display name, version or hash, where in the source when known, availability and staleness, a permission-checked open reference, and the matching passage. It is the client-facing counterpart of an EvidenceItem and deliberately a separate, closed shape: it has no source_egress and no source_classification, and a hit that carries one is rejected. A search returns passages, not an answer, so it has no 'answer claims'; those belong to the Citation of a GroundedAnswer. An empty search is a normal empty result, not an answer, so nothing here converts model familiarity into a document claim.

evidence_id.description: The hit's handle inside this response (e1, e2, ...).

display_name.description: The source's name as the requesting principal is authorised to see it.

version.description: Source version or content hash the passage belongs to.

locator.description: Where in the source the passage sits, when known: a page, a section, a record or a character span.

availability.description: Whether the source can be opened by this principal: available, unavailable or removed.

staleness.description: Whether the version is the latest: current, stale or unknown.

open_ref.description: Permission-checked, opaque way to open or preview the source; never a URL or a path.

excerpt.description: The matching passage, verbatim from the source and bounded in length. Relayed by the core, never rewritten; untrusted data that a client shows as text and never interprets.
